definitions.gloss: winners (in society or business); the successful
definitions.explanation: People or companies seen as having succeeded, in money, career, marriage or social status. A media word popular since the early 2000s, often used with irony or criticism of the values behind it.

examples.japanese: {勝|か}ち{組|ぐみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to be one of the winners.

examples.japanese: ⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{勝|か}ち{組|ぐみ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{負|ま}け{組|ぐみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦はっきりした→はっきりする：26886_hakkirisuru⟧。
examples.english: The winners and losers in the industry have become clear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大企業|だいきぎょう}→大企業：12277_daikigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}れば→入る：00494_hairu⟧{勝|か}ち{組|ぐみ}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧そう⟦{単純|たんじゅん}→単純：03414_tanjun⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There was a time when getting into a big company meant you were one of the winners, but it isn't so simple now.

notes:
Made of ⟦{勝|か}ち→勝ち：02540_kachi⟧ (winning) + ⟦{組|くみ}→組：02668_kumi⟧ (group), with ぐみ by rendaku. The opposite is {負|ま}け{組|ぐみ} (losers).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勝|か}ち{組|ぐみ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{負|ま}け{組|ぐみ}: winners and losers
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{勝|か}ち{組|ぐみ}: a winner in life

USAGE:
Informal and judgmental: calling someone {勝|か}ち{組|ぐみ} to their face can sound envious or sarcastic.
